recommendation: Keep the source fix. It aligns active Location guidance with the applied issue family without duplicating the already-audited Address.type and Location.contact decisions.
issue_request: FHIR-2840 was Published/Persuasive with Modification and asked how a Location with a single Address could carry both a physical address and a mailing address such as a PO box. The recorded disposition rejected adding a physical/postal code to Address at that time and proposed a Location-level element or extension.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-2840 was found. Current source already has Location.address as the physical location and, through later FHIR-25375/FHIR-29035 work, Location.contact 0..* ExtendedContactDetail for location-level contact addresses. The remaining Location.address comment still directed additional addresses only to another Location resource or the Organization, leaving the current location-specific contact-address path unclear.
additional_context: FHIR-6088 later revisited the same physical-vs-postal family and added Address.type postal|physical|both for general Address use; it is already represented on the combined branch. FHIR-25375 and FHIR-29035 added Location.contact using ExtendedContactDetail, which includes purpose and address; FHIR-25375 is also already represented on the combined branch. PA Zulip and Confluence evidence confirms role/purpose-specific contacts at both organization and location level.
reconciliation: Updated source/location/structuredefinition-Location.xml so the Location.address comment now sends additional physical addresses to another Location resource, location-specific mailing/billing/contact addresses to Location.contact.address, and only non-location-specific addresses to the organization's contacts.
source_changes: source/location/structuredefinition-Location.xml: clarified the Location.address comment to distinguish additional physical addresses from location-specific mailing, billing, or other contact addresses handled through Location.contact.address.
